home.title: Nedir Gala
home.about_section_description: The private enterprise 'Nedir Gala' was established on March 7, 2011. It operates based on the Certificate of Entry into the Unified State Register No. 23675020, issued by the State Registration Department for Institutional Aspects and Investment Projects of the Ministry of Economy and Development of Turkmenistan on February 24, 2017, and its own charter. 'Nedir Gala' has been engaged in entrepreneurial activities for many years, achieving effective results. The company has completed the construction of several facilities under relevant licenses. This includes the construction and installation of large-scale buildings for 'UPPK2', 'UPPK3', '4 substation buildings', and the 'Foundation of the steam boiler building' in the Yoloten district of Mary velayat, commissioned by 'Chuangxing Drilling Engineering Company with Limited Liability under CNPC' in Turkmenistan between 2011-2012. Additionally, under a 2018 contract, it carried out pipeline laying work for the 'Construction work for laying pipelines under the railway in the agreed area of Turkmenistan 'Bakhtiyarlyk''. Currently, a contract has been signed for construction work on a project to lay a pipeline under the railway and highways in the agreed 'Bakhtiyarlyk' section, and work has begun. From 2014-2016, commissioned by the Akhal velayat khyakimlik, construction began on 40 mortgage houses in the village of Bereketli Zaman, and several bridges were built on the Turkmenabat highway in 2015, commissioned by the state concern 'Turkmenavtoyollary'. The company also constructed cottage-type residential buildings in the city of Anew, Akhal velayat, from 2019-2022. 'Nedir Gala' was allocated a 7-hectare plot of land for 39 years to build a greenhouse for growing vegetables in the Tejen district of Akhal velayat. In accordance with the 'State Program for the Production of Import-Substituting Goods in Turkmenistan,' the first stage of the greenhouse and production workshop on a 3.5-hectare plot has been completed and put into operation, with construction ongoing on the remaining 3.5 hectares. Tomatoes are planted and harvested in the 3.5-hectare greenhouse. The Tejen district administration has allocated pastures for livestock. Requests have been sent to acquire an additional 200 hectares of land near the greenhouse and 70 hectares in the Ak Bugday district. Orders have been placed for world-leading agricultural machinery to develop the land. 'Nedir Gala' is the official representative of the Swiss elevator manufacturer 'SCHINDLER Elevator CO. Ltd' in Turkmenistan.

product_base.description: In accordance with Investment Agreement No. 6/4 of November 13, 2013, between the Union of Industrialists and Entrepreneurs of Turkmenistan and the private enterprise 'Nedir Gala', a land plot of 2.08 ha was allocated from the industrial zone in the Ak Bugday district of Akhal velayat. lift.text: 'SCHINDLER' elevators are optimal in price, quality, and design, fully complying with world standards. They are currently installed and used in several large residential and socially significant facilities in Ashgabat and Arkadag cities, as well as in the country's velayats. Our qualified specialists, who have undergone special training abroad and hold relevant certificates, provide maintenance services for these high-quality elevators to ensure safe and uninterrupted operation in multi-story residential buildings and facilities.

greenhouse.title: Our Greenhouse Complex
greenhouse.location: Turkmenistan, Tejen district of Akhal velayat
greenhouse.text: As a result of the tireless efforts of our esteemed President to support entrepreneurial activity, the large-scale and multifaceted nature of the work of our country's entrepreneurs indicates the positive results of state program measures to stimulate and support private entrepreneurship. In accordance with the decision approved by the order of the President of Turkmenistan No. PB-7783 of January 13, 2017, the Private Enterprise 'Nedir Gala' was allocated a land plot of 7 hectares for 39 years for the construction of a greenhouse for growing vegetables in the Tejen district of Akhal velayat. Currently, 3.5 hectares of our greenhouse are yielding crops. Since 2019, more than 500 tons of tomato harvest are collected annually from 3.5 hectares of the greenhouse, and the products are sold in domestic and foreign markets.

tomate.title: Our Tomato Plant
tomate.location: Turkmenistan, Tejen district of Akhal velayat
tomate.text: In accordance with the decision approved by the order of the President of Turkmenistan No. PB-7783 of January 13, 2017, the Private Enterprise 'Nedir Gala' was allocated a land plot of 7 hectares for 39 years for the construction of a greenhouse for growing vegetables in the Tejen district of Akhal velayat. Currently, 3.5 hectares of our greenhouse are yielding crops. The construction of the greenhouse and production workshop on the allocated plot has been completed and put into operation. The greenhouse and workshop are currently functioning, producing tomato and ketchup products under the 'Dayhan' brand. In addition, pickled melon products are bottled in glass containers. In the future, it is planned to establish mayonnaise production.
